title: Scoped negative result: five-cube copy floor for any single Boolean mask
body:
This scoped structural proof removes the degree restriction from the common one-mask five-cube decoder floor. For any Boolean mask h and any finite number of exact binary outer-product terms with both factors in span{1, parity, h}, the rational pairing-rank sum is at least 32. The known parity totals attain 32. Under the inherited additive stage ledger, even granting all other costs zero leaves deficit at most -32. No new kappa or physical supplier is claimed.

The proof decomposes the two parity orthogonal bases, partitioned by h, into one- and two-dimensional components. It also gives an exact term-rank formula and five binary-rank potentials. This adds arbitrary-degree, arbitrary-term-count coverage beyond PR1222's quadratic masks and PR1177's three-term bound. PR1482's two-mask result remains outside the theorem. The proof credits PR1046/958/231 and the retained copy/frame lineage; no pending executable or theorem is imported.

Validation: two separately written implementations (integer elimination and Walsh/Fraction reconstruction) agree on 15,876 ordered rational ranks for 324 mask fixtures. They check all 125,440 component-graph edges and 128 degenerate coefficient lifts. Nine mathematical controls, five corruption/relocation test groups, selected-record integrity and five selected-record regressions pass. The universal claim comes from the written proof, not the fixture sample. Both implementations share the same AI-assisted author.

Reproduce with Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/five-cube-arbitrary-mask
```

Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/five-cube-arbitrary-mask outcome=negative-result`.

Research base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`; OS-random seed 42, structural decoder track. Only `research/five-cube-arbitrary-mask/` is added. Exact pins, full proof, receipt, overlap coverage and open questions are included. The final full scan covered 715 open PRs and 217 discussions; the nearest PR heads were rechecked unchanged. Source pins and the selected certificate remain unchanged on refreshed main.

Limits: common code and full all-pairs identity only; no two-mask or different-reader/source-code theorem, physical hosting/frame/precision admission, full selected-supplier replay, proof-assistant verification, independent human review or hosted-CI success is claimed.

Prepared by Hanson Sun (@bbMisk) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, proof, both implementations, verification and writing. Apache-2.0.
